profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Draeger Medical Systems
profile.summary:
In my software engineering career, I have focused on the product development of software solutions and computer systems.  Using a disciplined approach, the goal is to develop products that are of high quality and exceed the customer's expectations.  This goal has been pursued through individual contributor and leadership roles.  My philosophy for product development is the success of the product is the direct result of the effort of all members of the product team.  

Engineering Skills Summary:

Programming:
C/ C++, Object Oriented Programming, Standard Template, Library, SQLite, Boost Library, Multi-Threaded Programming

OS/Platforms: 
Microsoft Windows, Ubuntu Linux, WindRiver VxWorks, Android, VMware Workstation, Oracle VirtualBox

Requirements: 
Rational DOORS

Version Control:
Rational ClearCase, GIT

IDE: 
Microsoft Visual Studio, CodeBlocks, Eclipse, Wind River Workbench

IMS:
Serena TeamTrack, Redmine, Jira

Build:
Jenkins

Test:
Google Test, Google Mock

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior staff software engineer contributing to the design and implementation of the next generation networked patient monitor.   
• Lead software engineer for “Persistence” software, which provides capabilities to store data on non-volatile storage, using a SQLite database:
    ◦ An emphasis in the design was the performance of data storage on an embedded system. [C/C++,
       SQLite, VxWorks, Workbench, Visual Studio, Google Test, Google Mock]
    ◦ Participated in FMEA activities related to data storage, which contributed to reduced product risk, and
       improved product reliability.   
• Lead multiple software/hardware integration activities, requiring:
    ◦ Managing the integration of software features on hardware.  [C/C++, VxWorks, Visual Studio]
    ◦ Managing the release of software.  [GIT, Jenkins]
    ◦ Supporting team members in evaluating system behavior.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead software engineer providing software consulting services in the Altran embedded
systems group. Performed investigations into new technologies and design for the
product line architecture of an industrial water cutter product. The product included an
embedded Linux controller, which was networked to a host control system.
• Prototyped the technologies for communications between the embedded Linux
controller and the host system. [HydraExpress C++ web services, gSOAP C++ web
services, RabbitMQ messaging]
• Investigated design issues and integration issues of the embedded Linux controller,
and the product line architecture.
• Created the initial development plan for the embedded Linux controller software, and
its integration into the product line architecture.

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal software engineer (at a small start-up) leading the commercialization of the
SmartShield product software. The SmartShield product is a system of networked
radiation detectors, with a “command and control” application. The system included (1) a
smartphone application [Android OS], connected to a radiation detector through a
Bluetooth connection, (2) a “command & control” application [Ubuntu Linux], and (3) a
server component [Ubuntu Linux] used to manage network connections.
• Used minimal resources to leverage a prototype system to create a commercial
product.
• Collaborated with Product Marketing to define the product software requirements.
• Implemented user interface features, and infrastructure enhancements for the Android
smartphone application. [C/C++, JAVA, Android OS, Eclipse IDE, Android Studio
IDE]
• Implemented user interface features, and infrastructure enhancements for the
“command and control” application. [C/C++, Boost Library, QT, Ubuntu Linux,
CodeBlocks IDE].
• Managed software releases through software configuration control and the build
system. [GIT, Jenkins]
• Provided technical support to Product Marketing during critical product
demonstrations. [VMware Workstation]
• Developed shell scripts used by Manufacturing to deploy products. [Linux, Bash]
• Lead software quality assurance activities by defining a quality assurance strategy,
and prioritizing quality assurance activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer E4
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for integrating a modified ultrasound beamformer into a new
Windows 7 based ultrasound product.
• Developed the requirements, design, implementation, and integration of software for
the modified ultrasound beamformer. [C/C++, Windows 7, Green Hills embedded
RTOS]
• Integrated the new ultrasound product into the existing automated test environment
infrastructure, through collaboration with the software quality assurance team.
• Worked across the R&D organization, and managed the software change control, to
ensure the new ultrasound product was implemented as part of the product line
architecture.
• Provided primary software support to the project team across multiple sites, which
included triaging of issues, and technical assistance.

positions.title: Software Engineer E4
positions.description:
Project Engineer for software development activities to build a new Windows XP based
ultrasound product. The Project Engineer role is accountable for ensuring all software
deliverables for the product (1) meet stakeholder expectations, (2) delivered with high
quality, and (3) completed on schedule.
• Collaborated with the business team and software team to define the software
requirements, software design, schedule, and scope. Through this activity, business
and engineering needs were aligned.
• Collaborated with cross functional leaders on a regular basis to plan, execute, and
monitor engineering activities. This was achieved by actively managing the project
schedule, scope, and resources.
• Lead the software team through the product development lifecycle. The software
team was a mid-sized team, distributed among three sites, domestic and international.
• Partnered with the software team, cross functional leaders, and the business team to
periodically integrate and review software features. This ensured the product was
converging for release.
• Partnered with the software quality assurance team to integrate the product into the
existing automated test environment infrastructure. This was used to monitor software
quality metrics for early detection of software defects.
• Managed the software release process, ensuring software was released in a controlled
manner.
• Provided technical support to stakeholders during internal/external product
demonstrations.
• Contributed to Philips’ efforts to attain CMMI Level 3 accreditation in the Ultrasound
Division.

positions.title: Software Engineer E3
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for Service features on an ultrasound product.
• Lead a small team in delivering service features for an ultrasound product. [C/C++,
STL, Windows XP]
• Service features included a client-server application used to collect service data from
a remote ultrasound system.
• Worked cross functionally with the Philips Service organization to establish service
requirements and design for a future ultrasound product.

positions.title: Software Engineer E2
positions.description:
Individual contributor assigned to a small team to improve product quality on a Windows
XP based ultrasound product under development.
• Partnered with program management and engineering staff to improve the software
quality through the following activities:
o Review product requirements and cross feature functionality with development
teams for accuracy.
o Review organizational compliance to development processes.
o Identify and prioritize risk areas based on historical data, development activities,
and defect rates.
o Implement quality improving activities and corrective actions based on prioritized
risk areas.
• Risks to the schedule and product quality were identified and reduced.

positions.title: Software Engineer E2
positions.description:
Individual contributor assigned to the Software and Systems Department.
• Contributed to the investigation of system requirements for a future Windows XP
based ultrasound product.
• Accomplishments included working with diverse teams to derive requirements,
facilitating cross-site investigations and communications, and authoring technical
whitepapers to inform technical leadership with background material.
• Technical responsibilities included delivering the “Wireless LAN” feature, which
involved infrastructure software to manage wired/wireless network connections, and
integration of the Microsoft IEEE 802.11 wireless implementation into the ultrasound
product. [C/C++, STL, Win32 API, Windows XP]

positions.title: Software Engineer E2
positions.description:
Lead software engineer for the embedded ultrasound beamformer team for a medical
ultrasound product.
• Lead the design and implementation of features for the command/control
infrastructure and embedded beamformer software. [C/C++, STL, Windows XP,
Green Hills embedded RTOS]
• Worked with hardware engineers to design and prototype a new ultrasound
beamformer.
• Deliverables included creating the requirements, design, implementation, test plans,
and system integration of specified features.
• Assisted software reliability improvement efforts through defect triage, log analysis,
feature integration test, and regression test planning.
• Authored a software development guide used to train software engineers on
development procedures for the ultrasound product.

positions.title: Software Engineer E2
positions.description:
Individual contributor assigned to the embedded ultrasound beamformer team for a
medical ultrasound product.
• Contributed to the design and implementation of command/control infrastructure for
the embedded ultrasound software. [C/C++, STL, Windows XP, STL, Green Hills
embedded RTOS]
• Deliverables included creating the requirements, design, implementation, test plans,
and system integration of specified features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Individual contributor employed by a small, start-up, software consulting firm.
• Worked with a client to develop the requirements and high-level design for a custom
dial-up software application that integrated with Internet Explorer. The software application provided safe access to the Internet for children. [C/C++, Win32 API,
Windows NT]

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Individual contributor on the Platinum*  LANDesk Configuration Manager product, used
to remotely administer PCs.
• Designed and implemented features to remotely install operating systems and
software applications. [C++, Win32 API, Windows NT]

* PLATINUM Technology purchased the LANDesk Configuration Manager product from the Intel
Corporation in December, 1997

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Individual contributor on the Intel LANDesk Configuration Manager product, used to
remotely administer PCs.
• Developed a software test suite for the product. [C/C++, Win32 API, Windows NT]
